metric_definitions.via_in_pad: canary's via_in_pad.py count on the saved board
metric_definitions.power_layer_traces: freerouting-dev power-traces on the routed DSN and session, its `all` count (every trace on a power-type layer); 0 under enhanced's power_layer_traces=none
metric_definitions.clearance: KiCad error-severity clearance, hole_clearance, copper_edge_clearance, shorting_items and tracks_crossing items, each type minus the unrouted input's count (floor 0), summed. Role guard: no candidate row above the baseline's (N02's hard guards: no new DRC error)
metric_definitions.kicad_unconnected: KiCad's unconnected_items on the saved board
metric_definitions.drc_real: every error-severity type other than unconnected items and starved thermals, minus the input's (reported)
metric_definitions.copper_edge_clearance: KiCad's count on the saved board (K09.4 keepouts are on in every arm)
metric_definitions.inner_tracks: canary's inner_tracks.py count (on canary-pwr every inner layer is a plane; on the demos it counts inner signal layers and is not a fault)
metric_definitions.wall_seconds: the router process's wall time (K09.7: the plugin run's time); one job at a time, machine load not controlled

keep_rule: a candidate passes against plugin-default when (1) no hard metric above 0 on a judged row, (2) clearance not above plugin-default's on any judged row, (3) the kicad_unconnected total over the four judged boards improves by more than the set noise 17.14, (4) no judged board worse by more than twice its band. Among the passing candidates, those whose total is within the set noise of the best passing total are tied and the tie goes to the smallest summed wall_seconds (K09.7's time budget); a remaining tie goes to the arm with fewer options. The winner's options (minus schema and profile) become kicad-plugin options.PROFILE_DEFAULTS['enhanced']; if none passes, it stays {} and K09.9's note gives the numbers. The engine's ENHANCED is not changed here: a board-independent setting found to win is proposed for it through N05's recipe on the engine bench set
stop_rule: one registered run per arm per row; no reruns with other settings, no row dropped

decision_table.pass: PROFILE_DEFAULTS['enhanced'] = the winner's options, test_options/test_route_dialog updated, K09.9 ticked with the table if canary-pwr's default run grades <= 33 clean, else [x] on the accept clause's 'or the number and the cause'
decision_table.fail: PROFILE_DEFAULTS['enhanced'] stays {}; K09.9 note gives the table
